entities.summary: Danny Miranda Agramonte is a Cuban former first baseman who played his entire career for Ciego de Ávila of the Cuban National Series. Miranda has represented Cuba at many international competitions including the 2004 Summer Olympics in Athens, where the Cuban team won the gold medal.
